en: The front of the postcard displays a vintage black and white photograph of a grand building with a bridge and a reflective pond in front. The surroundings are lush with trees. The building is labeled 'Pyrmont Schloss.' The image is overlaid with cursive handwritten text in German. The reverse side has a traditional old-fashioned postcard format with 'Postkarte' printed in German, a green postage stamp, official postal marks, further handwritten script, and a marking from a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
